title: Digital Marketing Projects

Page Objective
The Digital Marketing Projects page is designed to show how I approach marketing from a strategic and execution-focused perspective: identifying a business problem, selecting the right data, evaluating performance, and recommending action.

title: Marketing Analytics Projects
text:
These projects demonstrate my ability to apply quantitative methods to marketing problems and communicate insights in a business-ready format.




Managerial problem: Determine which marketing channels are driving website traffic and how media budget should be allocated more efficiently.


Methods: Exploratory analysis, correlation review, linear regression, channel comparison, and ROI-focused interpretation.


Business impact: Supports smarter budget allocation by identifying high-performing channels and areas of inefficient spend.


Marketing Mix ModelingRegressionBudget Allocation


Open project folder →





Managerial problem: Understand how different marketing touchpoints contribute to customer conversion behavior.


Methods: Attribution modeling, conversion path analysis, funnel interpretation, and channel contribution review.


Business impact: Improves channel credit allocation and supports more accurate campaign performance measurement.


AttributionCustomer JourneyConversion


Open project folder →





Note: This project can be listed carefully as a private or summarized project if NDA restrictions apply. Avoid publishing restricted data, dashboards, names, screenshots, or proprietary details.
